title: Structuring and Closing a Civic Address

sections.content:
You know *en resumen* and *lo más importante es que* from B1 Unit 13, *por último* from A1 Unit 8, and *en segundo lugar*, *en definitiva* and *en suma* from B2 Unit 28. A formal civic speech relies on these signposts—along with formal *en primer término*—so an audience can follow a multi-point commitment aloud.

1. **Opening and ordering pillars:** *en primer término* ('first of all', more formal than *primero*) opens the main sequence; *en segundo lugar* continues it; *por último* closes the list before the final synthesis.
2. **Synthesising before the call to action:** *en definitiva* ('in short / ultimately') and *en suma* ('in sum') distil a long speech into one guiding principle: *En definitiva, la convivencia democrática depende de la participación ciudadana*.
3. **One marker per turn:** set each marker off with a comma and never stack two closing markers together (write *En definitiva, …*, never *En definitiva, en suma, …*).

sections.title: Signposting a civic address
rows: En primer término, quisiéramos reforzar la participación ciudadana.
Formal opener for the first pillar of a speech.
En segundo lugar, ampliaremos los espacios de consulta popular.
Second ordered point in the sequence.
Por último, fijaremos una agenda pública transparente y verificable.
Final item in the ordered sequence.
En definitiva, la convivencia democrática es una tarea cívica compartida.
Synthesis closing before the final appeal.

items.spanish: En primer término, conviene abrir la agenda pública a las propuestas de los barrios.
items.english: First of all, it is advisable to open the public agenda to proposals from the neighbourhoods.

items.spanish: En segundo lugar, toda consulta popular requiere información clara antes de la votación.
items.english: Secondly, every public consultation requires clear information before the vote.

items.spanish: Por último, el referendo local debe servir para fortalecer el compromiso cívico.
items.english: Lastly, the local referendum should serve to strengthen civic commitment.

items.spanish: En suma, la convivencia democrática crece cuando las instituciones escuchan a la ciudadanía.
items.english: In sum, democratic coexistence grows when institutions listen to citizens.

sections.content: Match the marker to its exact position in the speech: do not open a brand-new topic with *en definitiva* or *por último*, and never stack two synthesis markers (*en suma, en definitiva*). Keep *en primer término* parallel with *en segundo lugar* and *por último*.
